title: Atelier Rorona Plus: The Alchemist of Arland

info.about: Atelier Rorona: The Alchemist of Arland is a Japanese role-playing video game developed by Gust Co. Ltd. It first released for the PlayStation 3 on June 25, 2009, in Japan and was later re-released under the PlayStation 3 the Best label on September 23, 2010.
